title: {Syn} AlphaTensor Used Learning to Search for Matrix Algorithms
content:
AlphaTensor framed matrix multiplication algorithm discovery as a game and used reinforcement learning to search for efficient tensor decompositions.

The result was not that AI replaced proof, but that learned search could surface useful algorithmic candidates in a highly structured mathematical space.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
